records.title: First Ascent of Mount Everest
records.description: The historic first successful summit of the world's highest peak via the South Col route.

records.title: First Ascent of K2
records.description: Conquering the notoriously difficult 'Savage Mountain' for the first time.

records.title: First Winter Ascent of Nanga Parbat
records.climbers: Simone Moro, Alex Txikon & Ali Sadpara
records.description: The last eight-thousander to be climbed in winter, ending decades of attempts.

records.title: First Ascent of Annapurna
records.description: The first eight-thousander ever climbed, a milestone in mountaineering history.

records.title: Fastest Ascent of Everest (North)
records.description: Solo ascent from base camp to summit in under 17 hours without oxygen.

records.title: First Woman to Summit K2
records.description: The first female ascent of K2 without supplemental oxygen.

records.title: 14 Eight-Thousanders in Record Time
records.description: All 14 eight-thousanders climbed in just 6 months and 6 days as part of Project Possible.

records.title: First Ascent of Matterhorn
records.description: The iconic Alpine peak first climbed, ending the golden age of alpinism.

records.title: Oldest Everest Summiteer
records.description: Reaching the summit at 80 years old, the oldest person to stand on Everest.

records.title: Youngest Everest Summiteer
records.description: The youngest female to summit Everest at just 13 years old.

records.title: First Ascent of Broad Peak
records.description: The first eight-thousander ascent performed in alpine style without oxygen.

records.title: Solo Ascent of Everest without Oxygen
records.description: The first solo ascent of Everest without supplemental oxygen, a legendary feat.
